$comment: Same shapes as case-study/full. site.caseStudy.media is the layout the site sets once for its case studies (Next.js's media prop, WordPress's options page), not a value stored per case study: aside draws the featured image beside the parts it runs alongside (the challenge, the solution and the live-site link), which the view counts and writes as --salt-case-study-view-aside-rows; the measure is a default band's, 64rem. The delivered service sits below the parts, confined to the measure, so its card takes the card slot in the default band. Two results draw data-columns 2.
summary: A case study in the aside layout: the featured image, as the priority image, beside a challenge, a solution and the live-site link, under a header with the client and two results; one delivered service card below them, confined to the measure; no back link, details or gallery.
